name: Naphtha (petroleum), catalytic reformed; Low boiling point cat-reformed naphtha; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons produced by the distillation of products from a catalytic reforming process.  It consists of hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C4 through C12 and boiling in the range of approximately 30°C to 220°C (90°F to 430°F).  It contains a relatively large proportion of aromatic and branched chain hydrocarbons.  This stream may contain 10 vol. % or more benzene.]
